issue.title: Fix false positives, false negatives, warnings and errors in CI/CD

repository.name: medical-neural-network-ml
repository.description: A plan to do research on how to teach medical neural network for processing medical data

issue.body:
Fixes #4

## Summary

This PR checks every CI/CD run on `main` at `fd7703e` and every file under `.github/` and `scripts/` for false positives, false negatives, warnings and errors, and fixes them. It also compares the files with the [Python template](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template) and reports the shared problems there.

The issue's snapshot showed "0 not passing" only because two runs were still in progress. Both finished red: [CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259374) and [Security](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259420).

The collected data is in [`dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5`](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/README.md):

- [requirements.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/requirements.md): every requirement of the issue and where it is met
- [analysis.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/analysis.md): each finding with root cause, fix and test
- [research.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/research.md): online sources and the existing tools considered
- [template-comparison.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/template-comparison.md): the file comparison with the template
- [ci-logs/](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/ci-logs): the log excerpts cited

### Findings and fixes

| # | Kind | Before (log on `main`) | Fix | Regression test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | error, false positive | `PyPI answered 422 to the mint-token probe (no verdict on trusted publishing)` → `verified nothing (1 unknown)` | `scripts/preflight-credentials.sh` reads PyPI's 422 error code. `invalid-publisher` and `invalid-pending-publisher` are now a FAIL that prints the trusted-publisher fields to enter and the right PyPI page. Other codes stay unknown. | 9 cases in `tests/test_preflight_credentials.py` |
| F2 | error, needs a human | `Dependency graph is disabled ... A repository admin must enable it` | Already explicit: it warns on PRs and fails on `main` with the setting to change. No code change. | (existing) |
| F3 | warning | `--strict-concatenate is deprecated; use --extra-checks instead` | `extra_checks = true` in `pyproject.toml` | mypy itself |
| F4 | warning | lychee `./**/*.html: No files found for this input source` | Directory input `.` with `--extensions md,html --hidden`, `dev/log` excluded. Checks the same 47 files. | `test_links_workflow_fails_for_every_broken_live_link` |
| F5 | warning | zizmor `running in offline mode by default; some audits ... will not be available` | The pedantic pass gets the read-only `GH_TOKEN` and runs online like the action pass | `test_workflow_audit_job_runs_zizmor` |
| F6 | false negative | A PR changing only a `.sh` script or `.json` data skipped lint, tests, build and changelog | `.sh` and `.json` count as code in `scripts/detect_code_changes.py` | `test_shell_and_json_changes_activate_jobs`, `test_excluded_folders_win_over_code_extensions` |
| F7 | false negative | Model tests did not run on PRs changing `tests/test_medbench_real_data.py`, `scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh` or `pyproject.toml` | Added to `model-tests.yml` `paths:` | `test_pull_request_paths_cover_every_file_the_jobs_run` derives the list from the workflow |
| F8 | latent false negative | `Upload artifacts ... if-no-files-found: warn`: an empty `dist/` passes the build | `if-no-files-found: error` | `test_every_artifact_upload_fails_when_it_finds_no_files` (all workflows) |
| F9 | latent false positive | With the default `queue: single`, a third release cancels the one still pending | `queue: max` (with `cancel-in-progress: false`) on both release writers. `.github/actionlint.yaml` ignores only actionlint 1.7.12's `unexpected key "queue"` message until [rhysd/actionlint#654](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/issues/654) | `test_queue_max_is_never_combined_with_cancel_in_progress`, the ignore-list assertion |
| F10 | maintenance | `actions/checkout@v6`, `setup-python@v6`, `cache@v5` | v7, v7, v6 in every workflow, including `model-tests.yml` | `test_no_workflow_uses_a_superseded_first_party_major` |

[analysis.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/analysis.md#not-defects) lists what was ruled out and why: the Codecov and Pages opt-in notices, the CodeQL option-schema dump, `--warning=no-unknown-keyword`, opt-in skipped tests, and keeping `docs/case-studies` out of lychee. A full run over that folder found 26 errors, mostly 403 bot-blocks from third-party sites.

### After

PR run [38728238909](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38728238909) shows the release preflight now giving the real answer instead of "no verdict":

```
FAIL: PyPI refused to mint an upload token (422 invalid-publisher: valid token, but no corresponding publisher (Publisher with matching claims was not found)) -- the publish step would be rejected the same way. A PyPI maintainer must add a GitHub trusted publisher with owner=konard, repository=medical-neural-network-ml, workflow=release.yml, environment=(blank) to the existing project "my-package" at https://pypi.org/manage/project/my-package/settings/publishing/. If that project is not yours, rename [project].name in pyproject.toml first.
```

The mypy, lychee and zizmor warnings are gone from the PR runs ([excerpts](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/ci-logs)).

### Two settings only a maintainer can change

No commit can make these green. Under the hive-mind practice for checks that need a human, they warn on this PR and fail on `main` with the exact steps:

1. **PyPI trusted publisher (R2a).** `pyproject.toml` still has the template name `my-package`, which belongs to someone else on PyPI. Rename `[project].name`, for example to `medbench` (free on PyPI on 2026-10-15). Then add a pending publisher (owner `konard`, repository `medical-neural-network-ml`, workflow `release.yml`, blank environment) at <https://pypi.org/manage/account/publishing/>.
2. **Dependency graph (R2b).** Enable it at <https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/settings/security_analysis> → Dependency graph → Enable.

This PR changes neither, because both are outward-facing: one publishes a package name, the other is a repository setting.

### Template

Every template CI file is in use here. Three improvements already proposed upstream were adopted: [#105](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/105) (`queue: max`), [#106](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/106) (lychee input, action majors) and [#107](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/107) (`.sh` detection).

Problems found here that also exist in the template, with evidence from its own `main` runs, were reported:

- [#108](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/108): preflight treats PyPI 422 as "no verdict" (F1)
- [#109](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/109): `strict_concatenate` deprecated (F3)
- [#110](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/110): pedantic zizmor pass runs offline (F5)
- [#111](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/111): dist upload `if-no-files-found: warn` (F8)
- [#112](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/112): Dependency Review fails every PR when the graph is disabled (F2)
- Comments on [#107](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/107#issuecomment-6191229980) (`.json`) and [#105](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/105#issuecomment-6191230506) (ignore in `actionlint.yaml`)

### How to reproduce and verify

- **Before.** Open the `main` runs [38725259374](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259374), [38725259420](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259420), [38725259341](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259341) and [38725259357](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38725259357), or the grep of their logs in [main-fd7703e-warnings.txt](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-4-9640ff7d8a06/dev/log/issues/4/pulls/5/ci-logs/main-fd7703e-warnings.txt).
- **Locally.** Run `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy src/` (no deprecation warning), `pytest` (591 passed, 43 skipped) and `python scripts/check_file_size.py`. Also run actionlint with `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -w /repo rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12 -color`, which exits 0 with `queue: max` in place.
- **Regression tests.** With this branch's `tests/` copied onto `fd7703e`, 29 tests fail there and pass here. `test_excluded_folders_win_over_code_extensions` passes on both: it guards that `docs/`, `changelog.d/` and `dev/log/` stay excluded now that `.sh` and `.json` count as code.

Changelog fragment: `changelog.d/20261015_issue_4_ci_false_results.md`.

issue.body: See screenshots: - https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/issues/4 - https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/issues/3 https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/issues/3 which contains bug label looks more correct. - https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/cd6419ce38f3545b523058c854db237b/raw/93fd2636c50136ccbba0af77dc08479a11ccda1d/tmp-hive-mind-log-upload-rhnygw-sanitized.log.txt - https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/5e87c377851a8c37f860010a024c1377/raw/c5db42a5965d047e7fa5b076c2511ae9c30f25b9/home-box-hive-telegram-bot.log.txt We also should wait for CI/CD to finish on default branch, before we actually start the task, we can still create the issue though as soon as we can. In telegram we can show separate waiting for CI/CD to finish status, so user knows what is happening. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
